data.body: [P2] Distinguish ReplayChildren contexts from skipped completed children. A `SUCCEEDED` context with a result exceeding the checkpoint limit re-executes with `ReplayChildren=True`. If its callback completes while suspended, this placeholder lets the eager input hook export the callback under the original deterministic parent before replay creates the current invocation's fresh parent segment. Deduplication then suppresses the callback's later delivery, leaving its continuation attached to a prior invocation. Defer these completions until the replay parent is registered; use the completed-parent fallback only when the context is actually skipped. Add a wait/resume regression with a large child result.
